title: Curing of base coats.
officialText:
Cement plaster base coats shall be cured in accordance with ASTM C 926. Cement plaster bedding
coats shall retain sufficient moisture for hydration (hardening) for 24 hours minimum or, where necessary, shall be kept damp for
24 hours by light water spraying.
